workloads.name: actor_heap_allocation
workloads.scope: Allocate 512 fixed-size young objects on one actor-owned heap.

workloads.name: local_message_round_trip
workloads.scope: Send and receive 256 ordered local actor messages.

workloads.name: scheduler_yield_cycle
workloads.scope: Run 256 cooperative scheduler slices that yield and requeue.

workloads.name: actor_local_collection_pause
workloads.scope: Collect a 512-object actor heap with eight precise live roots; heap setup is outside the timed pause.

workloads.name: actor_spawn_exit_churn
workloads.scope: Spawn and normally exit 256 root actors through the unified lifecycle.

workloads.name: mixed_actor_runtime_tail
workloads.scope: Combine managed allocation and collection, local messaging, scheduler yields, and actor teardown.
